feats.name: Skilled
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

feats.name: Adaptable
feats.description: Once per long rest, at the start of combat, you may discard your opening hand and redraw to your hand size.

feats.name: Determined
feats.description: Once per short rest, when you fail a skill check, you may try again without consequence.

feats.name: Spell Weaver
feats.description: Learn one Tier 1 spell of your choice that your character is otherwise capable of learning or casting. You use cunning for your magic attack.

feats.name: Elven Grace
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in Acrobatics or Stealth.

feats.name: Keen Senses
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in Perception or Investigation.

feats.name: Stonewise
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in History or Investigation. When examining stonework, masonry, tunnels, or underground structures, make these checks at advantage.

feats.name: Iron Stomach
feats.description: You have advantage when resisting mundane poison, spoiled food, or similar harmful substances.

feats.name: Second Breakfast
feats.description: When you draw an Ace, draw an additional card.

feats.name: Cheerful
feats.description: When you use Rallying Cry, the one ally receiving the benefit draws one additional card.

feats.name: Nimble
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in Acrobatics or Stealth.

feats.name: Friendly Face
feats.description: Gain Proficiency in Persuasion or Insight.
